project_type: Android App (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose) with Firebase Firestore backend
verification_instructions: Uninstall app completely, rebuild, install, login as admin, check logs for 'Fetched X employees' (X should be > 0), verify Firestore console shows employee documents
snapshot_or_generated_files: SeedData.kt contains seed employee data (73 employees). Firestore rules are deployed to Firebase Console manually.
environment_constraints: Firebase project must be configured in google-services.json. Firestore security rules require manual deployment to Firebase Console (not part of app build). App has no Cloud Functions, so token claims are never set by backend.
contribution_requirements: Follow WorkCore's standard patterns: use Result<T> for error handling, log with android.util.Log + TAG prefix, use Dispatchers.IO for database/network ops, follow existing naming conventions in data layer.
key_patterns: Data layer: FirebaseDataSource (Firestore ops) → WorkCoreRepository (business logic) → ViewModel. Error handling: Result<T>.fold() pattern. Logging: TAG + descriptive messages with emoji prefixes (✅, ❌, 📤, 📥, etc.).
directory_structure: app/src/main/java/com/example/ contains: data/ (entities, DAO, repository, Firebase), ui/ (screens, ViewModel, theme), util/. Firebase config in app/google-services.json (not in repo). Firestore rules at repo root: firestore.rules.
